title: Light-intensity dependence of visible-light CO2 reduction over Ru(II)-complex/Ag/polymeric carbon nitride hybrid photocatalysts
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01488J, Paper
Open Access

Ryuichi Nakada, Chao Zhang, Jo Onodera, Toshiya Tanaka, Megumi Okazaki, Guigang Zhang, Kazuhiko Maeda
This study provides insights into optimizing selective CO2 reduction to HCOOH over hybrid photocatalysts that consist of Ru(II) complex cocatalyst and Ag-loaded polymeric carbon nitride, based on the light-intensity dependent photocatalytic activity.
